import csv
from datetime import datetime, timedelta
import openpyxl


def format(path):
    """
    Reads a CSV file, subtracts 3 hours from every value in the 4th column
    (index 3, zero-based), and writes the adjusted data to
    /workspace/audit-export.xlsx.
    """
    output_path = "/workspace/audit-export.xlsx"
    offset = timedelta(hours=3)

    wb = openpyxl.Workbook()
    ws = wb.active

    with open(path, newline="", encoding="utf-8") as csvfile:
        reader = csv.reader(csvfile)
